title: Sicilian Defense: Grand Prix Attack
line: White pushes a pawn on the king's side and aims a bishop at Black's king; Black blocks it and strikes in the center.

steps.text: Here White brings a knight out and pushes the pawn on f2 two squares, to attack on the king's side.
Push the pawn on g7 one square, to make room for your bishop.

also.e7e6: That also works. This lesson goes on with the bishop.

steps.after: White's bishop aims at the pawn on f7, which only your king guards.

steps.text: Push the pawn on e7 one square. It blocks the bishop's line to f7.
Bring the other knight to e7. It backs up a pawn push in the center.
Push the pawn on d7 two squares. It hits the bishop and takes the center.
Castle. Your king goes to safety, and a rook comes toward the center.
steps.after: Your king is safe, and White's bishop now runs into your pawn on d5.

summary: Against the Grand Prix, Black blocks the bishop's aim at the weak square and then strikes in the center.
